import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-b3496m3k/bench_opencode_torch-tensor-parallelism_djimt27m")
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,16
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,5,I)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        Wm = W if cls is ColumnParallelLinear else torch.randn(O,I)
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data.copy_(Wm); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        m=cls(I,O,True,Wm)
        xr=x.clone().requires_grad_(); xm=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        yr=ref(xr); ym=m(xm)
        assert torch.allclose(yr,ym,atol=1e-5)
        yr.pow(2).sum().backward(); ym.pow(2).sum().backward()
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            c=O//ws; gw=ref.weight.grad[rank*c:(rank+1)*c]; gb=ref.bias.grad[rank*c:(rank+1)*c]
        else:
            c=I//ws; gw=ref.weight.grad[:,rank*c:(rank+1)*c]; gb=ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,gw,atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,gb,atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(xm.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-4)
    if rank==0: print("ok ws",ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
